title: guardian_remove
description: Formal spec §7.2 (REQ-7.2-6/7a/7b). Removes exactly one current guardian, named in outgoing.

outgoing.description: The guardian being removed. REQ-7.2-6: MUST be a current guardian and not the only one.

sigs.description: REQ-7.2-7a (voluntary): outgoing's own key, alone. REQ-7.2-7b (forced): enough of the other current guardians to meet removal_threshold, evaluated against the full current guardian set.
